title: Inception — A dream within a dream

hook.context: Cobb va uning rafiqasi Mal tushlar dunyosida yillar o'tkazgach, uyg'onish uchun shu gapni bir-biriga eslatadi: "poyezd seni uzoqqa olib ketadi..." Present Continuous — hozir davom etayotgan holat.

reading: Dom Cobb is a thief, but he doesn't steal money. He enters people's dreams and steals their secrets. He had learned this skill from his father-in-law long before the story begins.
Cobb cannot go home to his children in America, because the police think he killed his wife, Mal. In fact, Mal had died after she had lost the ability to tell dreams from reality.
A rich businessman, Saito, offers Cobb a deal. If Cobb does one last job, Saito will clear his name. But this time the job is not to steal an idea. It is to plant one. This is called inception.
Cobb builds a team: an architect who designs the dream worlds, a man who can change his appearance, and a chemist who makes strong sleeping drugs.
The plan is complex: a dream inside a dream inside a dream. Time moves more slowly on each level, so a few minutes in reality can feel like years in a dream.
Before the team entered the first dream, Cobb hadn't told them about his biggest problem: memories of Mal keep appearing and destroying his plans.
In the end Cobb returns home and sees his children's faces. He spins his small top to check if he is awake, but he walks away before it falls.

grammar.title: Past Perfect: had + V3
explain: **Past Perfect** — o'tmishdagi boshqa voqeadan **oldinroq** bo'lgan voqea: Cobb **had learned** this skill **before** the story began. Ikki o'tmish voqeasi bor — avvalgisi Past Perfect.
Tipik so'zlar: **before, after, by the time, when, already**. **By the time** we arrived, the film **had started**.
Agar voqealar tartib bilan aytilsa, Past Perfect shart emas: He woke up, looked around and smiled (hammasi Past Simple).
Inkor: **hadn't** + V3. Before they entered the dream, Cobb **hadn't told** them the truth.

exercises.q: When we arrived, the film ___ already started.
exercises.why: Biz kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan: had started.

exercises.q: Cobb ___ the skill long before the story began.
Before they entered the dream, he ___ them about Mal.
By the time the police came, the thief ___.
exercises.why: By the time + Past Simple → asosiy qism Past Perfect.

exercises.q: I was tired because I ___ all night.
She ___ the book after she had seen the film.
exercises.why: after allaqachon tartibni ko'rsatadi; keyingi voqea Past Simple.

exercises.q: ___ you ever seen such a dream before that night?
exercises.why: O'tmishdagi nuqtagacha tajriba: Had you ever seen...?

exercises.q: He realised that he ___ his keys at home.
